cs.t: It has Ubuntu Linux,  I installed a Plex server on it and have a Plex pass subscription for it.  I also have one of these  https://www.silicondust.com/hdhomerun/  I have Plex clients for Windows, Mac, Linux, XBOX ONE, PS4 and iOS.  I can watch TV and movies on my server or Live TV through the HDHomeRun, or have Plex work as a DVR.  I listen to music on my phone with the Plexamp client when I am at work or travelling on foot or in my car.  My only complaint is that some files don't play by default on the PS4 and I have to manually tell it to re-encode. I tried Jellyfin and never got it to really work right.  Plex is a consumer electronics-type experience and the Plex Pass is totally worth it.
